audit_items.proof_trace: All three implementations (LegionAbstractSale, LegionCapitalRaise, LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale) read `investedCapital` into a local variable and transfer that exact value via `SafeTransferLib.safeTransfer` with no arithmetic applied between capture and transfer. No fee is deducted and no rounding occurs; the guards (`whenSaleCanceled`, zero-amount revert, `_verifyHasNotRefunded`) are admission checks only and do not modify the transfer amount.
